summary: End-to-end testing of new 'Site Content' feature (admin /admin/content + public /api/content). Backend: added 4 new content tests to backend_test.py; full suite = 31/31 PASSED (incl. public GET defaults, admin PUT persist with en/hi texts + contact + toggles, 401 for guest, 403 for customer). Frontend: admin login OK → sidebar admin-nav-content (2 instances: desktop+mobile) routes to /admin/content; all target testids present (content-hero_title-en/hi, content-announcement-en, content-toggle-announcement_enabled, content-toggle-about_enabled, content-contact-phone/whatsapp/email/address, content-save-btn). Filling fields + toggling + saving shows 'Website content saved' toast. Home storefront reflects overrides: announcement-bar shows 'Fresh harvest every Tuesday', home-hero H1 shows 'Test Headline EN', about-section visible, footer-phone shows '9876543210', footer-whatsapp shows 'WhatsApp 9876543210'. Hindi lang-toggle-hi switches hero to 'टेस्ट शीर्षक'. Regression: /admin/notifications renders notif-table, /admin/products renders catalogue table — both OK.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend get_content strips _id/key via projection and falls back to CONTENT_DEFAULT when no doc exists — clean.
admin_update_content coerces each text entry to {en,hi} strings and contact values to strings — safe against injection of nested types.
Origin guard still correctly rejects PUT without matching Origin (verified via existing test_origin_guard_rejects_other_origin).
Minor suggestion (non-blocking): consider adding max-length validation on texts/contact to prevent oversized documents.
seed_data_creation: site_content doc upserted via admin PUT with Test Headline EN / टेस्ट शीर्षक, announcement 'Fresh harvest every Tuesday', contact phone/whatsapp 9876543210, email hello@example.com, address 'Raipur farm', announcement_enabled=true, about_enabled=true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: site_content collection has a 'site' document with overrides from this run — resetting to defaults requires another admin PUT with empty texts/contact. ContentContext fetches /api/content on mount so Home/Footer/AnnouncementBar reflect updates after page reload (verified).
